**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

<rule>
VIDEO FORMAT:
Strict 1:1 square aspect ratio.

BACKGROUND:
Pure green screen background (#00FF00) with a solid green floor.
The background and floor must be exactly the same color.
No scenery, environment, or additional objects.

CAMERA:
Fixed camera, straight-on front view, full-body wide shot.
The camera must remain completely stationary.
No panning, tilting, rotation, tracking, or zooming.

FRAMING:
The entire subject and all equipment must remain fully visible throughout the animation.
Maintain at least 20% safety margin around the subject on all four sides.
The camera must be positioned far enough away to capture all movements, including jumps, spins, and wide swings.
Nothing may touch or cross the frame boundaries.
Prioritize full visibility over subject size.

ANIMATION:
All movements must be performed at natural, normal speed.
No slow motion, speed changes, cuts, or transitions.
Movements must be smooth, coordinated, and physically realistic.
Maintain proper balance, realistic weight distribution, and natural joint movements.
No body deformation, clipping, or extra limbs.

LIGHTING:
Uniform flat lighting.
No shadows, reflections, highlights, or lighting changes.
The background must remain consistently pure green (#00FF00).
</rule>
<character>
A smooth, solid bright-red 3D humanoid mannequin with normal human proportions.

The character has no facial features, no clothing, no hair, and no decorations.

The entire body is uniformly bright red, with clearly defined anatomy and naturally articulated joints.

The character has empty hands and carries no equipment or weapons.
</character>
<action_description>
The character performs an energetic hip-hop dance routine.

Starting with rhythmic side steps and alternating arm swings, the character transitions into quick footwork, shoulder rolls, and smooth body waves.

The character performs a fast 360-degree spin, drops into a low crouch, and extends both arms outward.

The character then rises with a powerful jump, lands smoothly, and continues with rapid footwork and sharp upper-body twists.

Finally, the character performs a spinning step and finishes in a confident dance pose.
</action_description>

nodes.title: Note: GEM-X
widgets_values:
## GEM-X Video Motion Capture + FBX Character Retargeting

1. **Load Video:** Select a video file. In **Trim Video**, set `start_time` (start time in seconds) and `duration` (length to keep in seconds; `0` means until the end of the video).

2. **Run:** Click **Run** to perform motion capture first, then retarget the captured motion to the three characters on the right (**Mixamo / Unreal / Unity**).

3. **Preview Animation:** Click the Play button in each **Preview 3D** node to view the animation. The retargeted character FBX files are also saved in `output/gem_x/<task>/`.

### Retarget Node Settings

- **character:** Select a character from `models/gem_x/fbx`.
- **root_motion:** Disable this option to keep the character animated in place (without moving across the scene).
- **yaw_offset:** Adjust the character's facing direction (rotation around the vertical axis).

**Note:** Finger movements are not currently retargeted. Characters will retain their default hand poses.


---


GEM-X 视频动捕 + FBX 角色重定向

1. Load Video 选择视频；Trim Video 设置 start_time（开始秒）和 duration（保留秒数，0 = 到结尾）。
2. 点击 Run：先做动作捕捉，再把动作重定向到右侧三个角色（Mixamo / Unreal / Unity）。
3. 每个 Preview 3D 节点里点播放按钮查看动画；角色 FBX 也保存在 output/gem_x/<任务>/ 下。

Retarget 节点参数：character 选 models/gem_x/fbx 里的角色；root_motion 关闭后原地播放；yaw_offset 调整朝向。
手指暂不重定向，保持角色默认手型。

nodes.title: Prompt Hint
widgets_values:
### Prompt Structure & Guidelines

Our prompts follow three main sections:

- **`<rule>`**: Defines the background, aspect ratio, camera, lighting, and animation constraints.
- **`<character>`**: Describes the character's appearance, equipment, and weapons.
- **`<action_description>`**: Specifies the character's movements and actions.

**Important:** Keep actions simple and clear, maintain consistent character appearance, use a fixed camera, and ensure the entire character and weapon remain visible throughout the animation.

### 提示词结构与注意事项

我们的提示词分为三个主要部分：

- **`<rule>`**：定义背景、画面比例、摄像机、光照及动画约束。
- **`<character>`**：描述人物外观、装备和武器。
- **`<action_description>`**：描述人物的具体动作。

**注意事项：** 动作描述应简洁明确，保持人物形象一致、摄像机固定，并确保人物及武器在整个动画过程中完整入镜。

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
